notes: Runs the main QUnit suite (npm 'test:main') directly against lodash.js (the file the suite loads; the npm 'pretest' dist build is not needed for it). /opt/tc/qunit-extras-tap.js preloads qunit-extras and prints one TAP line per QUnit test. Only the devDependencies the suite needs are installed (qunit-extras, qunitjs, and lodash@4.17.13 as the 'stable' comparison copy). The fp suite (test/test-fp.js) tests dist/lodash.fp and is not run.
